answer: Start from the precondition: keys must be bound to work. Each session key signs a fixed number of completed tasks, then rotates. Attestations from a single subnet get taxed 40%, so a vine of colocated agents pays more per vote than an honest one. Identities that wander across cheap exits hit the same tax at the horizon of the first shared subnet. The cheapest attack has to cost more than honest work, and this holds it there.
